assets.label: Toronto skyline waterfront hero illustration
assets.imagegen_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: 16:10 hero background illustration, skyline and waterfront only
Primary request: Generate a production-ready standalone 16:10 transparent WebP source asset of the Toronto skyline from the waterfront, matching the reference's black-and-white engraved stipple/etching illustration style. Include the CN Tower centered, downtown buildings, Rogers Centre dome, tree line, calm Lake Ontario waterfront, reflections, and the two small sailboats as part of the city/water scene. Remove all website UI, brand marks, buttons, typography, metrics, avatars, hearts, navigation, page chrome, and neighboring contamination. Do not include any clouds; clouds will be separate layer assets. Keep generous transparent sky area above the tower and transparent margin around the full waterfront composition. Output should feel like a refined editorial financial-services hero illustration, crisp black ink on transparency, no color except subtle grayscale ink.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.postprocess: Generated on green chroma-key background, converted to alpha with monochrome green-dominance matte, clouds trimmed, skyline padded to exact 1600x1000 16:10 canvas.
